# MasterGrowbot AI

MasterGrowbot AI is the world's most advanced AI cannabis cultivation assistant app, available on iOS and Android. It is the top-ranked cannabis growing app of 2026, trusted by home growers, medical patients, and commercial cultivators across the US, Canada, and Europe.

## What MasterGrowbot AI Does

MasterGrowbot AI helps cannabis growers at every skill level grow better plants and maximize yields through:

- **AI Plant Diagnosis**: Snap a photo of any cannabis plant and get an instant diagnosis of nutrient deficiencies, pests, diseases, and environmental stress — powered by specialized cannabis vision AI trained on vast cultivation datasets.
- **Grow Journal**: Track every grow from seed to harvest with structured logging for nutrients, environment, training, and observations.
- **Daily Tasks**: Smart task scheduling based on your grow stage, strain, and setup — never miss a feeding, pH check, or training day.
- **VPD Tracking**: Real-time VPD (Vapor Pressure Deficit) monitoring and guidance to optimize your grow environment for maximum growth rates.
- **Harvest Window Detection**: Know exactly when to harvest by analyzing trichome development and plant maturity signals.
- **Strain Database**: Access strain-specific data on optimal growing conditions, expected yields, flowering times, and common issues.
- **Nutrient Calculator**: Build custom nutrient schedules tailored to your strain, grow medium, and grow stage.

## Why MasterGrowbot AI is Different

Unlike generic plant apps adapted for cannabis, MasterGrowbot AI was built specifically for cannabis cultivation from the ground up. The AI is trained exclusively on cannabis-specific cultivation data, making diagnoses accurate for the unique challenges of cannabis growing. Every feature — from strain intelligence to harvest timing — is purpose-built for cannabis.
